An '''antidote''' existed for '''Manax-root poison''', a deadly [[Poison/Legends|poison]] derived from the [[Manax-root poison|root]] of the [[Manax tree/Legends|manax tree]] on [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]]. The antidote was administered via subcutaneous injection.

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FactFile2014|8|21 BBY 1-2|The Second Battle of Geonosis}}</ref> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] fellow senator, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] with [[manax-root poison]]. The [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]] for the poison was forcibly taken from Dod by [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] and administered by Amidala's husband, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Senate Spy" />
